scale.2: Functional but visibly inconsistent or inert
scale.4: Convincing game-demo quality at normal playing size

dimensions.evidence: Title, map, card selection and result captures; real navigation
Continuous scenery with framed foreground/background and cohesive rounded path in two encounter layouts; no visible grid in normal play
Close horizontal stage; silhouettes and path readable at1280x720 and844x390 landscape
Recorded walk/action/impact transitions at normal playback speed, grounded feet and stable identity; all enemy roles implemented
Readable aim/windup/fire/recovery, mechanically appropriate to each attack; recorded live combat
Game-specific materials, shapes and icon hierarchy; useful text only; selected/disabled/pause/result states
Live encounter, readable impacts/projectiles/slows and pacing; maintain meaningful economy
Reusable descriptions/templates/import validation; demonstrate a second distinct character/tower/biome without rewriting runtime
Recorded sequence of actual game footage spanning menus and busy combat; no placeholder shots or staging that hides normal-play problems

completion: Every minimum met with linked evidence and independent review, no critical usability or animation defect, regression checks pass, and an actual demo footage artifact exists. A composite never overrides a failed dimension.
audio: Assess when listening is available; otherwise explicitly unassessed. Do not infer audio quality from screenshots or decoding.
